subject: Escuta, Fala, Pensamento e Imaginação
description_pt: Participar de situações de escuta de textos em diferentes gêneros textuais (poemas, fábulas, contos, receitas, quadrinhos, anúncios etc.).

components.description_pt: Participar atentamente em experiências de escuta com gêneros textuais diversos
components.description_en: Participate attentively in listening experiences with diverse text genres
components.cc_component_description: Listen attentively to others without interrupting during classroom discussions

components.description_pt: Reconhecer gêneros textuais diferentes como poemas, fábulas, contos e receitas através da escuta
components.description_en: Recognize different text genres such as poems, fables, tales, and recipes through listening
components.cc_component_description: Identify common characteristics of a literary text type such as a poem or storybook

components.description_pt: Responder a textos de gêneros diferentes ouvidos durante experiências compartilhadas de escuta
components.description_en: Respond to texts from different genres heard during shared listening experiences
components.cc_component_description: Respond to prompts about a shared text to show basic understanding during group reading

cc_matches.description: Recognize common types of texts (e.g., storybooks, poems).
Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions (e.g., gaining the floor in respectful ways, listening to others with care, speaking one at a time about the topics and texts under discussion).
Actively engage in group reading activities with purpose and understanding.
